description: Plan de Prévention des Risques Naturels (PPRN) Inondation du bassin amont de l'Agout - Tarn is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tarn.gouv.fr. The COVADIS data standard for risk prevention plans includes all the technical and organisational specifications for the digital storage of geographical data represented in the risk prevention plans (RPPs). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Natural Risk Prevention Plan (NRPP) Flood of the upstream Agout basin — Tarn" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondations, données ouvertes, agout, tarn. The listing shows 2014-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
